programme.desc: Górnik Zabrze started the 2025/26 season with a 2-1 victory against Lechia Gdańsk. In the second round, Michal Gasparik's players go to Gliwice to meet Piast, for which it will be the first meeting in this year's competition.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Pogoń Szczecin – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: In recent years, the Port team came close to winning the Polish Cup and winning the Ekstraklasa podium. Robert Kolendowicz, Pogoń's coach, assures that the failures have not hampered the team. In his opinion, the Pride of Pomerania is much more hungry for success than its most dangerous rivals in the country. This is reflected in the movements of Szczecin's players on the transfer market. In the ongoing window, the Navy and Burgundy squad was strengthened by, among others: midfielder José Pozo from Śląsk and Paul Mukairu - former winger of FC Copenhagen. From Pogoń's perspective, however, the key factor may be the fact that despite interest from foreign clubs, Efthymios Koulouris, who scored 28 goals in the last Ekstraklasa season, will not leave the team. In the second round of the 2025/26 campaign, Portowcy will be tested by Motor Lublin. The ambitions of the Yellow-White-Blue are much higher than their seventh place at the end of the previous competition. Motor, on the other hand, wants to show that he has established himself among the elite and poses a real threat to the league leaders. We'll see if he will make a comeback from the match from November last year, when he defeated Pogoń 4:2

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lechia Gdańsk – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: The first matches of Lech Poznań this season could not fill the fans of the Polish champion with optimism. Kolejorz lost the national Super Cup match against Legia 1:2, and at the inauguration of the Ekstraklasa it was defeated 1:4 by Cracovia. However, the Poznań team rose from its knees and won against Icelandic Breidablik 7:1 in the Champions League qualifiers. Lech will try to transfer the form from this match to the league pitch and defeat Lechia Gdańsk

programme.title: Hero from the Shadow – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza | E02
programme.desc: The series presents the profiles of people working behind the scenes of Polish football clubs. They perform very important duties necessary for the functioning of the team, which are often invisible to outsiders. Krzysztof Kozik has been the manager of the first team of Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza for 20 years. He has been a resident of Nieciecza since birth. In the 1980s, he reactivated the LZS Nieciecza football club, which is an Ekstraklasa newcomer in the 2025/26 season. Kozik, known as Kiero, was also an active player and scored 245 goals for the team in the lower leagues. Poland. documentary series

Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Animals: masters of survival – Hunters | S01E05
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories. Viewers will learn fascinating hunting tactics, excellent teamwork and incredible speed, endurance and camouflage skills. They will see the 20 most dangerous animal predators. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Animals: Masters of Survival 2 – Toughest | S02E01
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories... Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Animals: Masters of Survival 2 – Masters of the Water Element | S02E02
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories... Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: African predators: the big four – Lions | E01
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Animal Wars – Cold Fury | E01
programme.desc: Animal species will be presented that can use their amazing features to defeat sometimes larger opponents. By perfecting them, they became true masters of communication, combat and camouflage. The world of snow, extreme cold and icy waters means that animals are always ready for battle. Panthers and polar bears living in frosty areas are real warriors. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Underwater City – Spring | S01E01
programme.desc: The Great Barrier Reef ecosystem is a unique and biologically diverse area, one of the largest structures of this type in the world. Like a bustling city, the reef harbors many distinct neighborhoods inhabited by coral and other animals, including lagoons, sandy islands and coastal rainforests. Each of these places has a unique rhythm of life, depending on the tides and times of day, as well as the variability of the seasons. Beneath the surface of the ocean and on its shores there is an ecosystem resembling a bustling city, full of migrants and natives. Filmmakers observe, among others: a green turtle looking for a mate. The cassowary takes care of the chicks. Australia. 2024. nature series

programme.title: Off the Coast of Australia – Tropical Coasts | E01
programme.desc: Viewers can see the coast of the Northern Territory and the vibrant waters around the Great Barrier Reef. Lizzie Daly will look at the dangerous creatures that swim there and why so many of them live there. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Pacific – On the high seas | S01E01
programme.desc: The creators of the program talk about the Pacific Ocean, the largest ocean in the world, covering an area of ​​170 million square kilometers. Viewers will have the opportunity to look at the coral reef and see the local beaches and capes. They will also learn about the inhabitants of water, from crabs and sea cows to the more predatory rulers of the ocean. The creators of the program present viewers the Pacific Ocean, an ocean that covers almost half of the world. They explain that its waters could accommodate seven continents. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Oceans | S01E01
programme.desc: Autorzy zapraszają widzów w podwodne podróże po oceanach, bagnach i innych akwenach z różnych stron świata. W każdym odcinku ukazują bogactwo odwiedzanych ekosystemów, prezentując złożone relacje między zamieszkującymi je organizmami. Filmowcy nurkują w najciemniejsze morskie głębiny oceanu, aby zobaczyć najbardziej tajemnicze stworzenia. They accompany humpback whales as they traverse vast open waters and admire the breathtaking phenomenon of bioluminescence on the ocean floor. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Coasts | S01E02
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Filmmakers travel along the coast, at the junction of several ecosystems. They observe hunting killer whales, the first jumps of guillemot hatchlings and the journey of young turtles to safe shelters. They also admire crabs carving sand galaxies. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Fall | E01
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. It's fall in Canada, and the cold winter will soon begin. The animals have little time: they must make the most of the available food before it disappears under the deep snow and ice. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Winter | E02
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Canada is covered in ice and snow. The animals are going through a difficult time right now: beavers are eating the food they collected in autumn, and arctic foxes are looking for food wherever they can. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Spring | E03
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Spring in Canada is a time when most animals breathe a sigh of relief after a cold winter. Unfortunately, spring is late this year. When it finally comes, there will be little time left to start a family. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Summer | E04
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Summer is a time of plenty for most animals - but not for polar bears. These predators cannot hunt seals until the sea freezes over. They are getting hungrier every day. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Survive in the wild North
programme.desc: Canada has the world's largest area of ​​intact primeval forest, over two million lakes and rivers, and the longest coastline on Earth. This wild and rugged area is inhabited by many fascinating wild animals. These include bears, arctic foxes, wolves, Canadian lynxes, flying owls, great owls, caribou and seals. Viewers will see how fauna copes in such difficult conditions to survive, taking advantage of the opportunities offered to representatives of different species in each season... USA, Canada, Austria. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Greater Africa – Luangwa Valley | E01
programme.desc: An extraordinary and fascinating adventure in the last wild, majestic deserts of Africa. The creators present a completely new look at the wonders of the Dark Continent and its amazing nature. The Luangwa Valley is one of the largest concentrations of wild animals in the world. 10,000 square kilometers of plains and forests owe their existence to the waters of the great river. South Africa. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Tsavo – Times of Prosperity | E01
programme.desc: In southern Kenya, as a result of the extraordinary cooperation of elephants and termites - the largest and smallest animals in Africa - a unique waterhole was created... USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Diego Rodríguez» Diego Rodríguez was a professional footballer from 1977 in his native Tenerife until 1998 when he decided to leave Albacete Balompié to play for Dos Hermanas. An expeditious and brave defender, he played 6 years and 198 games with Betis, of which he became captain until he signed for Sevilla. A change of colors that is traumatic in its meaning between the two teams from the same city and that still remains in the memory of the green-and-whites who have not forgiven him, and the white-and-reds who venerate the person who was also their captain. At the Nervión club, Diego played 8 seasons, 252 games

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Diego Rodríguez

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (2): That Cádiz, oé» Captures the essence of the Tacita de Plata and its people treating football (and what football is not: carnival, joke, art) through generational blocks (the Cádiz of the promotions of the 70s of Baena, that of the 80s of Mágico and Mejías, that of the 90s of Kiko, Mami and Arteaga that was always saved in the last day, and so on until the Cádiz de Cervera of the last promotion) and characters (Rovira, Macarty, Manolo Santander). It is a tour of its football milestones and its people to discover why Cádiz and Cádiz are so special

programme.desc: «Robinson Report (7): The passion according to Chimy Ávila» When Ezequiel Ávila walked through the door of his house in a precarious neighborhood of Rosario, Argentina, he came across a soccer field. Growing up in that pasture in a forgotten corner, the boy nicknamed Chimy, the fifth of nine siblings, has become accustomed to overcoming extreme situations: economic shortages, complaints, years without playing, the serious illness of a newborn daughter and, now, a serious injury at the best moment of his career. But the Osasuna player has overcome any obstacle clinging to his passion for football and his religious convictions.

The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. d/f Sunken treasures of the Nubian pharaohs
programme.desc: The 2,300-year-old royal tomb of a Nubian pharaoh appears largely intact, submerged in rising groundwater. The Water Tomb of Nastasen is located at the ancient site of Nuri, which lies on more than 170 acres of sand along the eastern bank of the Nile River in northern Sudan. When viewed from the sky, its most impressive feature is the arch of about 20 pyramids built between 650 BC and 300 BC. These pyramids are marked by the burials of Kushitic royalty, the "black pharaohs" who acted as vassals in the gold-rich southern fringes of the Egyptian Empire, but who emerged as a force in their own right during the political chaos that followed the decline of the New Empire. programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2017. S1, Ep4 «Super Senses: The Secret Power of Animals»…Our human senses are pretty incredible – but we only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there. There is a hidden world that animals across the globe can experience. In this episode we journey through the world of sound – from the deepest rumbles to the highest squeaks. Using specialised technology presenters Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee experience sounds beyond the range of our human hearing. They reveal how alligators use low pitch rumbles to make the water around them 'dance', they show what it's like to be a bat and to «see» with sound, and they convert a classic camper van into a giant speaker to conduct the ultimate hearing test for a herd of elephants | Incredible three-part documentary series in which hosts, biologist Patrick Aryee and physicist Helen Czerski, explore the extraordinary world of animal senses, doing various experiments and demonstrations featuring a variety of species. Each episode explores a extraordinary sense in the animal world- sight, sound and scent | Director: Sam Hodgson | Cast: Marc Holderied, Andre Kotze, Bruce Thigpen

programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Saudo Arabija. Год: 2017. S1 «Rooted»…Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari, a magnificent Camelthorn towers from amongst the blackthorn bushes. The tree stretches its branches towards the heavens as if to embrace the landscape around it. Growing from but a sapling, it has transformed into the imposing thorn tree it is today. The Camelthorn has been anchored to its spot in the Kalahari for two centuries. From the colony of Sociable Weavers that nest within the tree's grasp, to the larger herbivores that feed on the tree's pods, there is an abundance of life that visit the tree | Documentary series examining the staggering wildlife activity on five of Africa's most iconic trees. programme.title: Guardians of the Wild: Operation Rhino (S2E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep4 «Guardians of the Wild»…Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, they're back. Poaching hasn't gone away – their horns are still prized in Asian medicine. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation – it doesn't get any tougher | They are the protectors of the precious, wild animals that roam Zambia's dramatic landscapes, aiding them with medical care and protection from sinister poachers, standing proudly as the guardians of the wild. Our planet is in danger of losing these remarkable species of animals, from elephants to black rhinos, mainly due to the disdainful pilfering of their ivory. These conservationists risk their lives to protect these beloved creatures, whether it's the aforementioned species, Kinda baboons, lions, or leopards, monitoring their numbers and attempting to ensure their future remains as positive as possible. Documentary series | Director: Jason Holmes

programme.title: Hard working animals. Starlings and oropendula
programme.desc: Shiny starlings are sociable birds: they build their nests next to their neighbors, and little by little a large city with hanging apartments grows up. Their ball-shaped nests are built from intertwined grass and twigs collected near their colony. These houses are woven so well that they can support the weight of an entire family, including three or four chicks, and protect them from the tropical sun and rain. Another outstanding architect is building his house in the forests of Costa Rica: the Oropendola Montezuma or Trucial. Montezuma oropendolas are outstanding builders. They weave their nests from strips of banana leaves. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Cranes and wild boars
programme.desc: Vast areas of land in the Mediterranean grow nothing but olive trees. But birds and other foraging animals must eat. Their survival depends on olives. Among the collectors of fallen fruits there are some amazing ones. For example, cranes. At dawn, the industrious cranes begin their daily search for food. Birds are cold and need to eat well. At the same time, they spend a lot of precious energy on courtship in the form of dancing and calling. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Giraffes and ants

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM THÉP - IRON KUNG FU FIST
programme.desc: Liang Kun là một cao thủ võ thuật điêu luyện, rời bỏ giới võ lâm để bảo vệ người yêu. Tuy nhiên, sự biến mất của anh đã dẫn đến cái chết bi thảm của cô và khi Liang Kun tìm cách sống sót trong thế giới võ thuật, anh đã chiến đấu trở lại để trả thù cho cái chết của người yêu với sự giúp đỡ của một thủ lĩnh băng đảng ăn xin.

programme.title: TRỪ BẠO AN LƯƠNG - PUNISH EVIL
programme.desc: Một lô hàng tiền mới phát hành bị ba tên cướp có vũ trang cướp, khiến thám tử Chang phải điều tra. Lần theo những manh mối mới, anh đã hạ gục thành công một trong những tên cướp. Trong khi đó, hai người còn lại âm mưu cướp một xưởng vàng giữa lúc hỗn loạn. Với kế hoạch tỉ mỉ, Chang đã phá vỡ âm mưu của họ và đưa họ ra trước công lý.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM THÉP - IRON KUNG FU FIST
programme.desc: Liang Kun là một cao thủ võ thuật điêu luyện, rời bỏ giới võ lâm để bảo vệ người yêu. Tuy nhiên, sự biến mất của anh đã dẫn đến cái chết bi thảm của cô và khi Liang Kun tìm cách sống sót trong thế giới võ thuật, anh đã chiến đấu trở lại để trả thù cho cái chết của người yêu với sự giúp đỡ của một thủ lĩnh băng đảng ăn xin.

programme.title: TRỪ BẠO AN LƯƠNG - PUNISH EVIL
programme.desc: Một lô hàng tiền mới phát hành bị ba tên cướp có vũ trang cướp, khiến thám tử Chang phải điều tra. Lần theo những manh mối mới, anh đã hạ gục thành công một trong những tên cướp. Trong khi đó, hai người còn lại âm mưu cướp một xưởng vàng giữa lúc hỗn loạn. Với kế hoạch tỉ mỉ, Chang đã phá vỡ âm mưu của họ và đưa họ ra trước công lý.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: BẠCH PHÁT MA NỮ - BRIDE WITH THE WHITE HAIR
programme.desc: Đệ tử Thiên Sơn Yu Luo Sha thách thức bốn giáo phái lớn và giết chết các thủ lĩnh của họ, làm rung chuyển thế giới võ thuật. Trác Nhất Hàng đối mặt với cô nhưng lại yêu. Khi anh chuẩn bị kết hôn với người khác, cô tóc bạc trắng và thề sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại.

programme.title: THỢ SĂN MÁU: SỰ TRỖI DẬY CỦA QUÁI VẬT LAI - BLOOD HUNTERS: RISE OF THE HYBRI
programme.desc: Gabriella bị thôi thúc bởi sự trả thù sau khi một con quái vật lai tàn sát gia đình cô. Trong nhiệm vụ của mình, cô gia nhập một đội Thợ săn máu và họ cùng nhau tiến hành cuộc chiến chống lại các lãnh chúa tàn nhẫn của thế giới ngầm, gây ra một cuộc đối đầu tàn khốc.

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...
